audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTERS B AND C - the first multi-letter round of the Monster Manual II arc (the user call after the R797 shakedown). The pin-time walk from the print finds THIRTY-SEVEN entries on pp. 12-27: twenty-two B (the baku through the buckawn) and fifteen C (the cats through the cyclopskin). FORTY-THREE defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema: the thirty-seven stat blocks plus the ordinary bat, the soldier and bumblebee bees, the slicer beetle, the wild cat and the megalo-centipede form splits. THE GRIDS: the 26-row B and 17-row C stat grids (every armor class, hit-dice, hit, xp and lair cell of the stat blocks), the barghest growth brackets (hit dice 6+6 through 12+12, the armor class falling one place per die and the magic resistance rising 5% per die), the barkburr hit-dice ladder, the bloodthorn attack-data bands, and the cat lord feline and human-form summon bands. THE SETTLED READS: the behemoth LEVEL/X.P. prints VII/1800 + 15/hp (the capture primary); the cloaker xp/hp settles at 6 (the flat-6-HD boggart and slicer beetle both print 6/hp); the bumblebee queen prints 8+6 hit dice; the cave moray LEVEL/X.P. carries the roman II; the domestic cat MOVE prints 5 inches; the cyclopskin alignment prints verbatim. NO XP-AUDIT PATCH: mm2_print already rides the allowed-source list (the R797 patch). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 43 defs against the two stat grids, the planes, the xpValue formula and the registry census 491 -> 534.

banner.title: THE MM2 LETTERS B AND C - the thirty-seven printed B and C entries, the six form splits, promoted to the live registry
banner.provenance: Round two of the MM2 arc, the first MULTI-LETTER pass (the user call after the R797 letter-A shakedown: the arc does not run A to Z one letter at a time - the letters B and C walk together in one round). The capture is the Curtiss PDF upload (pp. 12-27, the full B and C sections) cross-checked against an independent transcription, the contested cells settled: the behemoth 1800 + 15/hp (the capture primary), the cloaker 6/hp (the book-internal tie - the flat-6-HD boggart and slicer beetle both print 6/hp), the bumblebee queen 8+6 (the capture hyphen is a plus misread), the cave moray roman II, the domestic cat move 5 inches. The pin-time walk finds twenty-two B entries (pp. 12-21) and fifteen C entries (pp. 22-27); the bat, bee, beetle, cat and centipede entries split two or three ways, so forty-three .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 491 -> 534. The stat blocks pin in the 26-row B grid and the 17-row C grid; the barghest growth brackets, the barkburr ladder, the bloodthorn attack-data bands and the cat lord summon bands pin as printed grids. The battery census reads loaded 534, errors 0. REPAIR (the landing run's one bad, the R639 flow): the R797 letter-A walk pinned the live registry census == 491 and this round's 43 defs grew it to 534, so the stale check read bad 1 and its early return truncated the battery into the R797-class census cascade (the wave was pure cascade - every label printing after the walk). Both walks now read the registry census as a FLOOR (fail only below the landing count), so later letter rounds cannot re-break a landed walk; the exact census stays pinned by the header consts and the audit mirror.

tables.name: the MM2 letter B stat grid
tables.audit_comment: the 26 x 9 B stat grid - the stat-block cells of the twenty-six promoted B defs in print order (the baku through the buckawn): armor class, hit dice, hit-die bonus, average hit points, attacks, base xp, xp per hit, lair percent and the primary move rate
col_comments: The ARMOR CLASS cell (the baku, boggart and crysmal negatives ride bare Lua numbers - a string drops the sign; the print strings ride the defs)
The HIT DICE number (the flat-hp forms read 0 - the loader flat-hp path; the 2-6, 7-10 and 5-30 ranges pin their low ends)
The HIT DICE bonus points (the buckawn 1-1 carries -1)
The average hit points (floor of dice x 3.5 plus bonus; the flat-hp forms carry the print value)
The NO. OF ATTACKS (the behir 1 and 1 or 1 and 6 sums to 9 - the loader sum-and-clamp; the boggle 3(2) reads 3)
The LEVEL/X.P. base value (the behemoth 1800 settled from the capture)
The xp per hit point (the cloaker 6 settled by the book-internal tie)
The % IN LAIR cell (Nil reads 0)
The primary MOVE rate in inches (the first N-M pair reads its low end)

The xp per hit point (the cave moray LEVEL/X.P. carries the roman II)
